summary: Kali365 is a phishing-as-a-service platform that automates OAuth device code phishing and adversary-in-the-middle session capture against Microsoft 365, using Cloudflare-hosted (workers.dev/pages.dev) landing pages that return real user_code values and let the platform collect the resulting access and refresh tokens. Post-access activity includes password changes, device registration and BEC-style inbox rule creation using special-character-only rule names. Red Canary also observed copy-and-paste ('paste and run') execution chains delivering Atomic Stealer, HijackLoader, NetSupport Manager and Scarlet Goldfinch payloads.
